event_var.var_meaning: overall survival status; 1 = death (event), 0 = alive / censored at last follow-up

notes: These fields appear in the GEO sample metadata characteristics_ch1 for tumor samples in GSE120622 (e.g., GSM3405969: death.event: 1; death.time..month.: 39).
The paper's Methods state that overall survival was analyzed with death classified as the event and patients censored at last follow-up, supporting the interpretation of death.event (1=event).

Time unit is taken from the variable name 'death.time..month.' and the Methods reporting follow-up in months (median follow-up 51 months). Values in the metadata include decimal months (e.g., 6.533333333).

Time origin (start time) is inferred to be time since surgery (op.date present in sample metadata and Methods refer to surgically-resected tumors and 'post-surgery' recurrence), but the exact origin is not explicitly labeled in the field name.
Some sample records have event flag but lack an explicit time field (e.g., GSM3406049 has 'death.event: 0' but no 'death.time..month.' entry in the provided metadata).

event_var.var_meaning: relapse/free-recurrence event; 1 = post-surgery recurrence (event), 0 = no recurrence / censored

notes: The relapse variables are present in GEO sample metadata characteristics_ch1 for tumor samples in GSE120622 (e.g., GSM3405969: relapse.event.1: 1; relapse.time..month.: 17.46666667).

The paper Methods explicitly state that post-surgery recurrence (>3 months) was classified as an event for relapse-free survival and that patients were censored at last follow-up or death (i.e., death is treated as censoring for RFS).
Time unit inferred from the variable name 'relapse.time..month.' and the decimal month values in the metadata.
As with OS, time origin is inferred to be time since surgery (op.date present and Methods reference 'post-surgery' recurrence) though the field label does not explicitly state the origin.
Event coding (1/0) is inferred from both the sample metadata values and the paper's event definitions.
